# Juan Gomez Vara — Product Designer

> Product Designer based in Berlin specializing in complex systems, UX research, and AI-augmented product design.
> License: RSL-1.0

## About

Juan Gomez Vara is a product designer who builds. His edge is seeing the full picture — from micro to macro — reading how systems connect, where they break, and what it takes to fix them. Background spans Michelin-starred kitchens, brand systems, and digital products, giving him pattern recognition most designers lack.

Today his workflow is AI-augmented by design, not by accident. He builds real products and treats AI as infrastructure, not a shortcut.

## Projects

- [Klaro](https://www.juangomezvara.com/project-klaro.html): AI fiscal advisor for Spanish-speaking freelancers in Germany. Eliminates the need for a Steuerberater, saving users €300–€800 annually. Built for the estimated 175,000 Spanish-speaking freelancers in Germany who face tax declarations in legal German. Full-stack product designed and built from scratch. Stack: Next.js, Claude AI, Supabase. Duration: 3 months.

- [Supply Pro](https://www.juangomezvara.com/project-supply-pro.html): B2B platform connecting professional chefs with suppliers. Helps restaurants recover up to €14,400 per year through proactive supplier management before problems reach the kitchen. UX research, product strategy, UI design. Duration: 4 months.

- [Micro-casing App](https://www.juangomezvara.com/project-micro-casing.html): Complete UX and brand redesign of a gamified interview coaching app for Cerebral Games. The redesign drove 508% growth in new user downloads, 7,700% revenue growth, and a 2.84% Day-35 conversion rate. UX strategy, branding, UI design. Duration: 2-week sprint.

- [Protonic](https://protonic-agenticsystem.vercel.app/): Contract-first, agentic design system built on React Aria. AI agents enforce design contracts — 15 components shipped, audited, zero violations across 5 architectural layers. Stack: React, TypeScript, React Aria, CVA. Role: Product Designer + Design Engineer.

- [Interactive Portfolio](https://interactive-portfolio-ashy.vercel.app/): An interactive 3D isometric RPG world where the portfolio becomes a game. Walk through neighbourhoods, discover projects, meet the designer behind them. Built with vibe coding techniques.

- [AI Playground](https://www.juangomezvara.com/ai-playground.html): Interactive experiments, games, and AI-powered prototypes built as design explorations.
